title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2013 英语一 Reading Text 1 · 本篇问题 4 题 + 历史弱项 4 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本篇复盘结果只有在你点击“提交结果到 GitHub”并在 GitHub 再点 Submit new issue 后，才会进入后续间隔复习。

questions.target: only when ... can't afford not to
questions.skill: 经济代价触发行为改变
questions.q: A café chain says it will only switch to reusable containers when it can no longer afford not to. Which change would most likely trigger that switch?
o: Disposable containers become cheaper.
All customers stop caring about waste.
Continuing to use disposable containers becomes too costly.
Reusable containers are banned by law.

exp.trans: 咖啡店连锁品牌说，只有继续使用一次性包装变得代价太高，它们才会改用重复使用的容器。
exp.structure: only...when表示必要条件；not to省略switch to reusable containers；can no longer afford限定无法继续承担不改变的代价。
exp.other: reusable 可重复用的；disposable 一次性的；trigger 触发；container 容器。
exp.meaning: cannot afford not to switch是承担不起不更换，而不是买不起环保容器；only when不应译成until的单纯时间截止。
exp.rest: 一次性容器更便宜不构成压力；顾客不在乎环保减弱动力；新容器被禁则无法执行更换。

questions.target: 引述立场 / 作者限定评价
questions.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
questions.q: An association calls volunteers “unreliable.” The author notes that missed visits often follow last-minute roster changes. “Better coordination,” she writes, “would be more useful than another lecture about commitment.” Which view belongs to the author?
o: She accepts the association’s description as an explanation for the missed visits.
She regards missed visits as evidence that volunteers want to leave.
She favours improving coordination over simply blaming commitment.
She considers punctuality irrelevant to the association’s work.

exp.trans: 某协会把志愿者称为“不可靠”。作者指出，缺席往往发生在排班临时变动之后。她写道：“更好的协调，比再说教一遍奉献精神更有用。”作者倾向改善协调，而不是简单归咎于态度。
exp.structure: An association + calls + volunteers + unreliable属于引述他人评价。The author + notes + that从句另给解释线索；would be more useful than是作者自己的比较判断，she writes确定说话者。
exp.other: association 协会；roster 排班表；last-minute 临时的；commitment 投入、责任心。
exp.meaning: 先分清谁在评价，再追踪作者自己的证据和限定比较。这里没有deserve或all，也不能把文章引用的标签直接记到作者名下。
exp.rest: accepts the description把协会标签当作者解释，忽略作者提供的排班因素；want to leave补出离开的动机；punctuality irrelevant把“协调更有用”扩大成准时无关，比较优先级不等于否认准时的重要性。

questions.q: No existing model explains the readings. They could conceivably point to a new process, although a faulty instrument remains another explanation. Which interpretation is justified?
o: A new process is a possible explanation, alongside an instrument fault.
The readings establish a new process and rule out an instrument fault.
The instrument fault has been confirmed by a separate test.
The new process is less likely than an instrument fault according to measured probabilities.

exp.trans: 现有模型都解释不了这些读数。它们或许指向一个新过程，但仪器故障仍是另一种解释。有依据的是两种解释仍可并存，新的过程只是可能性之一。
exp.structure: No existing model + explains + the readings。They指readings；could point to是谓语。although从句中a faulty instrument是主语，remains是系动词，another explanation是表语。
exp.other: reading 仪器读数；process 过程；faulty 出故障的；rule out 排除。
exp.meaning: conceivably没有把一种可设想的解释升级为发现。another explanation尤其限制了唯一性；也没有给两种解释排名。
exp.rest: establish ... rule out将可能性改成证实和排除；confirmed by a separate test虚构检验；less likely ... measured probabilities补出概率比较，原文没有量化数据。

questions.target: some与all / 尝试不等于成功
questions.q: A city festival generated considerable disposable-cup waste. Some stalls started using returnable cups, but single-use cups remained common. Which conclusion is justified?
o: No stall has taken any step to reduce waste.
Some stalls are trying to cut waste, although the problem persists.
All festival waste has been eliminated.
Every customer has stopped buying drinks in disposable cups.

exp.trans: 节庆活动产生了大量一次性杯子垃圾；少数摊位尝试使用可重复使用的杯子，不过一次性杯子仍很常见。
exp.structure: Some stalls started...交代部分行动；but...remained common限制实施效果，两句必须同时保留。
exp.other: disposable 一次性的；returnable 可回收再使用的；persist 持续存在；stall 摊位。
exp.meaning: some不能扩大为整个活动；部分努力不代表问题完全解决，而仍有垃圾也不表示完全无人行动。
exp.rest: 完全无举措否认原文明示的行动；垃圾彻底消除与remained common冲突；所有顾客拒买无证据。

questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

questions.target: imagined that ... had not / 提取完整观点
questions.skill: 信念内容不能由后续结果倒推
questions.q: Noor imagined that a software update had not changed her machine's output. Later measurements showed a substantial change. Which statement describes Noor's initial belief?
o: She initially thought the update made no difference.
She had decided to replace the machine entirely.
She knew from the beginning that output had changed greatly.
She was excessively enthusiastic about software updates.

exp.trans: Noor起初认为更新没有改变机器产出，后来的测量才发现变化明显。
exp.structure: Noor imagined that...中that从句作宾语；had not changed是其核心否定谓语；Later measurements引出相反事实。
exp.other: output 产出；substantial 显著的；measurement 测量；initial 初始的。
exp.meaning: 必须区分人物当时相信什么与后来实际发现了什么；不能只因出现update就推定其对软件痴迷。
exp.rest: 更换机器无依据；把后来证据当成最初已知事实颠倒时间；过分热衷更新是附加心理描述。

questions.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
questions.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

questions.target: descend 比喻从高端走向大众
questions.skill: 熟词语义在传播路径中的变化
questions.q: A monitoring technique once restricted to specialist hospitals gradually descended into community clinics as costs fell. In context, 'descended' suggests that the technique:
o: Became available to a wider, less specialized market.
Physically fell down a hospital staircase.
Was outlawed by every hospital.
Stopped being used because of lower prices.

exp.trans: 一种最早限于专科医院的监测技术，随着成本降低而逐渐普及到社区诊所。
exp.structure: A monitoring technique is subject; descended is predicate; once restricted to... identifies original level and into community clinics shows destination.
exp.other: monitoring technique 监测技术；specialist 专科的；community clinic 社区诊所；outlaw 禁止。
exp.meaning: descend的本义是下降，但搭配高端领域到大众场景的路径时，可理解成技术或潮流的层级下沉传播。
exp.rest: 物理坠落不涉及传播；违法和停止使用都无法由成本降低且进入社区诊所推出。

negative-ellipsis-afford.target: can't afford not to / 省略动作
negative-ellipsis-afford.skill: 双重否定和不定式省略
negative-ellipsis-afford.q: After a costly data leak, the agency began encrypting its archives. The director said, 'We can't afford not to.' What is omitted after 'not to'?
o: Encrypt its archives.
Cause another data leak.
Close every department.
Publish the stolen data.

exp.trans: 严重泄漏后，机构开始加密档案；主管说承担不起不加密造成的风险。
exp.structure: The action encrypting archives appears in the preceding sentence and is omitted after the final to; can't afford not to implies it must be done.
exp.other: data leak 数据泄漏；encrypt 加密；archives 档案；omit 省略。
exp.meaning: can't afford not to do X = 承受不起不做X的代价；to后可省略前面已经出现的动作，不是买不起做X。
exp.rest: 再次泄漏和发布失窃数据都是要避免的结果；关停全部部门未出现，均无法补全不定式。

negative-ellipsis-afford.target: more sustainably / 可持续与持续频率
negative-ellipsis-afford.q: A city newsletter urges residents to travel more sustainably by cycling or using buses instead of driving alone. Here 'more sustainably' means:
o: At exactly the same hour every day.
For a greater number of years.
By buying a new vehicle for each trip.
With less long-term environmental impact.

exp.trans: 城市简报呼吁居民骑车或乘公交来更可持续地出行，降低长期环境负担。
exp.structure: travel more sustainably是谓语不定式，by cycling or using buses说明实现方式，instead of driving alone明确对比。
exp.other: newsletter 简报；cycling 骑车；commute 通勤；environmental impact 环境影响。
exp.meaning: sustainably在生态语境指资源和环境方面可持续，而不是每天更持续、更多次地进行同一动作。
exp.rest: 同一时间、持续年数属于时间频率；每次购买新车反而增加浪费，都不是这里的评价维度。

author-stance.target: 事实描述 / 作者价值判断
author-stance.skill: 事实描述 ≠ 作者价值判断
author-stance.q: A report says that residents posted hundreds of angry comments after the council announced a parking plan. Which conclusion is directly supported?
o: The plan deserved every angry comment it received.
Residents posted a large number of angry comments following the announcement.
The council knowingly designed a harmful plan.
All residents opposed the plan.

exp.trans: 一份报告说，市议会公布停车方案后，居民发布了数百条愤怒评论。原文直接支持：居民在公告后发布了大量愤怒评论；after只说明先后，不能据此确定因果。
exp.structure: 主句：A report（主语）+ says（谓语）+ that宾语从句。that从句：residents（主语）+ posted（谓语）+ hundreds of angry comments（宾语）；after从句只交代时间。句子报告发生了什么，没有评价这些评论是否应得。
exp.other: council 市议会；announce 公布；substantial 大量的/显著的；reaction 反应。
exp.meaning: 负面评论的存在不等于作者认为批评对象活该。after只报告时间先后；要断言公告引发评论，还需要明确的因果证据。
exp.rest: deserved every angry comment加入作者价值判断和绝对化every；knowingly designed a harmful plan推测动机；All residents把数百条评论扩大成所有居民。

conceivably.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必然地
有这种可能，但不能确定
故意地
表面上地

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必然地接近certainly/inevitably，语气过强；故意地是deliberately/intentionally；表面上地是apparently/superficially，均不符合could...but no promise的弱可能语境。

conceivably.q: The damaged page could conceivably contain the date we need, but the faded ink cannot yet be read. Which claim keeps the writer’s certainty level?
o: 页面上已经确认写有需要的日期。
需要的日期很可能就在这一页，比其他页更有可能。
这页或许写有需要的日期，目前仍未证实。
这页故意省略了日期。

exp.trans: 那张受损的页面或许写有我们需要的日期，但褪色的墨迹目前还无法辨认。准确改写保留可能性，并说明尚未证实。
exp.structure: The damaged page是主语，could contain是谓语，the date是宾语；we need是省略关系代词的定语从句。conceivably修饰可能性；but之后the faded ink + cannot yet be read是被动谓语。
exp.other: damaged 受损的；faded 褪色的；ink 墨迹；certainty 确定程度。
exp.meaning: conceivably表示可以设想有这种可能。它既不是已经确认，也不自动表示比其他方案更可能。
exp.rest: “已经确认”抹掉could与无法辨认的限制；“很可能、比其他页更可能”加入原文没有的概率比较；“故意省略”把可能存在日期误写成有意不写，既换内容又补动机。

concession-claim-scope.target: 排放仍在 vs 部分公司减排
concession-claim-scope.skill: 让步限定防止以偏概全
concession-claim-scope.q: Cargo ships still produce substantial emissions. Nevertheless, several shipping firms have installed cleaner engines to reduce their impact. What is best supported?
o: All firms have eliminated shipping emissions.
Environmental impact has become irrelevant.
The whole shipping sector has refused any cleaner technology.
Some firms have attempted to limit environmental harm despite continuing pollution.

exp.trans: 货船仍然产生大量排放，但部分航运企业已安装清洁型发动机来减轻影响。
exp.structure: The first sentence confirms ongoing harm; Nevertheless introduces partial mitigation, while several limits the number of firms.
exp.other: cargo ship 货船；emissions 排放；shipping firm 航运公司；mitigation 减轻不利影响。
exp.meaning: 污染依旧存在，与部分企业已经尝试治理能够同时为真；不能由存在损害推出全行业完全无视问题。
exp.rest: 所有公司零排放与still冲突；环保影响无关紧要没有依据；全行业拒绝技术与several firms have installed相反。

belief-negation-clause.target: assume that ... did not / 被批评的信念
belief-negation-clause.q: A restaurant owner rebuked an apprentice for assuming that the online booking page did not influence walk-in customers. Surveys showed that many visitors discovered the restaurant through the page. What did the apprentice mistakenly believe?
o: The owner had never built a website.
The page could not influence customers arriving without reservations.
Customers preferred online orders to dining at the restaurant.
The owner was obsessed with online advertising.

exp.trans: 老板批评学徒，因为学徒以为网上订位页面不影响未经预约直接到店的人；调查却显示不少访客就是经此页面了解餐厅。
exp.structure: rebuked an apprentice为主干，for assuming that...说明批评原因，that后的did not influence是学徒持有的错误判断。
exp.other: rebuke 责备；apprentice 学徒；walk-in customer 无预约上门顾客；reservation 预约。
exp.meaning: assume/imagine that表示以为、认为；否定词位于从句中，决定被批评的是低估作用而非对网络的痴迷。
exp.rest: 老板是否建站、客人点餐偏好均缺证据；痴迷网络广告反而把漠视影响错误变成过度沉迷。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: A safety bonus can make a workplace more dangerous even when workers welcome it.
Anonymous surveys provide weaker safety evidence than official incident totals.
Workers respond more strongly to anonymity than to financial rewards.
Recorded events can increase because reporting changes, without a matching increase in hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 奖励后上报增多不能证明危险增多，调查反而指出发生频率未变；文中没有比较匿名调查和正式记录的证据等级；匿名是调查方式，奖励是先前制度变化，材料没有直接比较二者激励强度。

figurative-descent-relative.target: explained how... + in which 定语从句
figurative-descent-relative.skill: 分清主句、宾语从句与先行词
figurative-descent-relative.q: The engineer explained how a water-filter design had spread from research laboratories to neighborhood workshops, in which local volunteers built simple filters. Which account matches the sentence?
o: The volunteers moved the laboratories into their neighborhood.
The design reached workshops where volunteers constructed filters.
The engineer alone made every filter inside the research labs.
The water-filter design fell physically between two buildings.

exp.trans: 工程师解释了一种净水设计如何从研究实验室推广到社区工作坊，当地志愿者在这些工作坊制作简易滤水器。
exp.structure: explained后是how引导的宾语从句，design是该从句主语，had spread为谓语；in which引导定语从句，回指workshops。
exp.other: water filter 净水器；laboratory 实验室；workshop 工作坊；local volunteer 本地志愿者。
exp.meaning: 不能把物品技术的传播理解成实物降落；in which = in the neighborhood workshops，不等于in the research laboratories。
exp.rest: 没有说实验室被搬迁，也没有说所有滤水器由工程师独做；物理下落误解spread的传播含义。
